sites.name: Watson Lake Campground
sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.about: Small, remote Forest Service operated campground located above Tahoe City in north Lake Tahoe
sites.directions: Watson Lake Campground is accessed from Forest Road 16N73, approximately 10 miles west of Brockway summit on Highway 267

sites.name: Giant Gap Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $24 per night (6 people) Double Site: $48 per night (12 people) Triple Site: $72 per night (18 people) Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle per night Dump Station: $6 per use
sites.hours: Check in: 2:00 p.m.; Check-out: 12:00 p.m.; Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Giant Gap Campground is located on the north shore of Sugar Pine Reservoir, in the Tahoe National Forest. It is just 15 miles from Foresthill. Visitors enjoy the surrounding area for its fishing, canoeing, OHV and hiking opportunities.
sites.directions: From I-80:Take the Foresthill Road exit for 17 miles to the town of Foresthill. Continue on the road for 9 miles to Sugar Pine Road. Turn left and continue on Sugar Pine Road for 9 miles and take a…
sites.restrictions: OHV use is not permitted in Sugar Pine Complex, only in staging area
sites.reservations: This site can be reserved by calling Toll Free 1-877-444-6777 (International 518-885-3639 or TDD 877-833-6777) or on-line at Recreation.gov
sites.accessibility: Restrooms, several campsites and paved trail.

sites.name: Big Reservoir Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $24 per night
sites.hours: Check in: 2:00 p.m.; Check-out: 12:00 p.m.; Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Big Reservoir Campground (also known as Morning Star Campground)is located outside of Foresthill at Big Reservoir (Morning Star). For reservations at Morning Star campground call: (530) 367-2129
sites.restrictions: No boats with gasoline engines; no firearms or any other implement of destruction including sling shots and fireworks; no chainsaws; reservations must be made at least 3 weeks in advance

sites.name: Brimstone OHV Campground
sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.hours: Check in: 2:00 p.m.; Check-out: 12:00 p.m.; Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.about: Brimstone OHV campground is located adjacent to the Sugar Pine OHV trail system. It contains eight accessible campsites.
